from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-9fe52a62.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c] != 2]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        if not any(rr == r and cc < c0 for rr, cc in markers):
            for c in range(c0):
                out[r][c] = 2
        if not any(rr == r and cc > c1 for rr, cc in markers):
            for c in range(c1 + 1, w):
                out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        if not any(cc == c and rr < r0 for rr, cc in markers):
            for r in range(r0):
                out[r][c] = 2
        if not any(cc == c and rr > r1 for rr, cc in markers):
            for r in range(r1 + 1, h):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform', program_path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
test = [[0]*20 for _ in range(20)]
for r in range(2,9):
    for c in range(9,16): test[r][c]=2
for r,c in [(2,6),(3,19),(4,5),(7,1),(8,19),(12,9),(17,13),(19,15)]: test[r][c]=1
answer = mod.transform(test)
print('saved', program_path, 'dimensions', len(answer), len(answer[0]))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in answer))
